integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic viral short-video style, festive red-and-gold palette, a locked-off poster-like composition: a massive gilded Chinese character “骏” materializes dead center, its metallic gold surface gleaming, while behind it a herd of golden horses gallops across the frame in waves with motion-blurred streaks of gold light. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the character. At the bottom of the screen, a bold white subtitle reads “79年的羊，先别划走！”. A powerful, high-spirited male-style narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 79年属羊的注意了！到了马年后半程，你的好运局，已经全面开启了！</d> [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a rapid montage of three auspicious vignettes flashing in with punchy rhythm. First, a warm silhouette of a family sitting together around a glowing interior, and a giant character “和” bursts onto the screen with a golden flash. Second, a sweeping view from a mountain summit toward distant rising peaks bathed in morning light, and the character “旺” explodes on screen. Third, a lush grove of evergreen green bamboo swaying gently, and the character “宁” bursts forth. The narrator (S1) continues in an off-screen voiceover with rhythmic, building delivery: <d>[Chinese] 头一桩，家里和，家运渐旺；第二桩，前路旺，伯乐提携；第三桩，身心宁，平顺少忧！马羊相合，这可是难得一见的好兆头！</d> [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to the final freeze frame: a striking “吉” character on a vermilion-red plaque with a gilded border, its strokes subtly interwoven with the side-profile silhouettes of a sheep and a horse facing each other. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the frame settles. Below the plaque, a guide subtitle appears: “打出一句‘好运到’，把这波福气请进门！”. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover, uplifting and full of anticipation: <d>[Chinese] 打出一句‘好运到’，马年鸿运当头，我们一起迎来转机！</d> The frame holds on the glowing “吉” as the clip ends.

overall_soundscape: A deep resonant impact hit underscores each hard cut, with shimmering metallic whooshes as the gilded characters burst onto the screen. A faint rush of galloping hooves sweeps through the opening, followed by soft ambient warmth around the family silhouette, a light mountain wind, and the gentle rustle of bamboo leaves.

non_diegetic_music: Grand, festive orchestral percussion with driving taiko-style drums and bright brass swells at a fast tempo, building in intensity through the montage and resolving into a triumphant sustained chord under the final freeze frame.
